about.title: Software engineering beyond implementation.
about.intro: Experience with web systems and enterprise applications across maintenance, modernization, integrations, architecture and Full Stack development.
about.fallbackBio: Throughout my professional path I have helped build, maintain and evolve production systems, including legacy applications with established business rules and modern projects based on APIs and reactive interfaces. The focus remains on understanding the problem before choosing the technology.

architecture.title: Purposeful architecture
architecture.text: Complexity must be justified. Modular monoliths, queues, cache or separate services enter when the problem requires them.

security.title: Security by design
security.text: Validation, authorization, rate limiting, observability and secret management are part of the solution, not final polish.

maintenance.title: Code built to evolve
maintenance.text: Clean Code, SOLID, tests, useful documentation and explicit decisions lower the cost of future changes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how the portfolio processes personal data for contact, newsletter, security and optional analytics.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.text: The site may process data voluntarily provided through contact and newsletter forms, as well as technical data strictly required for security and operation.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.text: Data will be used to answer contacts, operate the newsletter, protect the service from abuse and measure usage only after consent when applicable.

sections.title: Rights
sections.text: Data subjects can request data export or deletion using the form below. Identity is confirmed through a one-time link sent by email.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.text: Data will be retained only for the period required by the stated purposes and protected with technical and operational controls appropriate to the risk.

request.title: Exercise your rights
request.description: Enter your email and choose an operation. To protect your data, we will send a verification link valid for 30 minutes. The response never reveals whether the address is registered.
request.type: What would you like to do?
request.deleteWarning: Deletion removes linked subscriptions and consent records and anonymizes contact messages. Once confirmed, it cannot be undone.
request.successFallback: If the address is valid, we will send a verification link.
request.errorFallback: We could not register the request. Please try again.

verify.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or has already been used.
verify.confirmDescription: This action anonymizes messages and removes subscriptions and data linked to the verified email. It cannot be undone.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: The site starts with essential preferences only. Analytics stays disabled until explicit consent.

sections.title: Essential storage
sections.text: Preferences such as theme and consent may be stored locally to preserve your selected experience.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: Analytics tools may only be loaded after consent when configured.

sections.title: Change preference
sections.text: Use the “Cookie preferences” button in the footer at any time to accept or revoke analytics.

cookiesBanner.title: Privacy under your control
cookiesBanner.text: We use essential storage by default. Analytics is not loaded without consent.
